# cidaas_webhook_events (Data Source)

The data source `cidaas_webhook_events` returns webhook-capable event IDs from your Cidaas instance (`GET /webhook-srv/eventdescriptions?category=webhook`). Use these values in `cidaas_webhook.events`.

 Ensure that the below scope is assigned to the client:
- cidaas:webhook_read



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `events` (Attributes List) Webhook-capable event descriptions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--events))
- `id` (String) Stable datasource instance id (random UUID).

<a id="nestedatt--events"></a>
### Nested Schema for `events`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Event identifier (`_id`), e.g. `ACCOUNT_MODIFIED`.
- `object_type` (String) Object type the event applies to, e.g. `users`.
